annotations.description: MCU temperature from the LPP telemetry request has stayed above 55 C for 10 minutes. Repeater telemetry is polled every 5 minutes, so this is at least two consecutive readings. There is no watchdog on nRF52 boards, so a thermal hang needs a physical power cycle.

model.query:
from(bucket: "meshcore")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mc_repeater_telem")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.type == "temperature")
  |> group(columns: ["repeater"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 5m, fn: max, createEmpty: false)
  |> drop(columns: ["_start", "_stop", "_measurement", "_field", "type", "channel", "pubkey"])
